name: flutter
label: Flutter (fvm)
description: Flutter SDK versions through fvm, from a .flutter-version file. Can install fvm itself.

tools.name: flutter
list: git ls-remote --tags --refs https://github.com/flutter/flutter </dev/null | sed -nE 's#.*refs/tags/([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$#\1#p' | sort -ruV | head -80

requires.name: fvm
check: if command -v fvm >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -x "${FVM_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/fvm}/bin/fvm"; then exit 0; fi; echo "fvm not found (install it: https://fvm.app/)" >&2; exit 1

instructions.macos: brew tap leoafarias/fvm && brew install fvm
instructions.any: curl -fsSL https://fvm.app/install.sh | bash   # installs to ~/fvm/bin; see https://fvm.app/
